payload.body: Audit for hv while vc waits on intent-dc's guards recipe: is as-written aligned with as-built? Your scope, code: the comments and header blocks in bin/molt, lib/*.sh, liberators/*.sh and the rendered templates, against the code beside them at v0.3.0 (db76a2c): a comment describing behaviour the code no longer has, a function named in a comment that no longer exists, a stale issue or ST reference, and any stored count or positional name hv's rule forbids. Read, don't fix: send vc findings as file:line, what it says, what the code does (with the code's file:line), and your proposed fix. Say what you checked and what you did not. vc reviews the blog post bl0001 itself. Reply 'nothing found' if clean.
